digest.component_or_area: CLI mutation verbs and confirmation output
propositions: Mutating CLI verbs currently exit silently on success, making idempotent no-ops indistinguishable from writes, causing agents to issue unnecessary follow-up rebar show calls and misinterpret silence as failure.

The CLI must emit one-line kubectl-style confirmations for every mutation verb: success lines in the form '<past-tense-verb> <args-summary>' and no-op lines as 'no change: <specific-reason>', both exiting 0.

Global --quiet and --output flags must be extracted at the router level before verb dispatch to uniformly support them on positional-only _REGISTRY leaves (comment, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands), with --quiet suppressing only confirmation text and --output json replacing text confirmations with a structured envelope.

Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) and silent verbs must be normalized to the shared confirmation contract without information loss; link's REDIRECT record and transition's UNBLOCKED ids must be preserved byte-identical in their existing output format.

Consumed seam return types (e.g. add_dependency's dict | None for REDIRECT records) must remain unchanged; confirmation signals must be added as parallel channels or derived from existing exposed outcomes without altering type contracts.
